article_framing_rejections.headline: Mother, grandfather, and girlfriend charged in malnutrition death of Fort Pierce infant

lead_independence.headline: Mother, grandfather, and girlfriend charged in malnutrition death of Fort Pierce infant
lead_independence.lead: Nicole Maxwell, Robert Maxwell, 61, and Vikki Koon, 38, are facing charges in connection with the child's death. The arrests come nearly a year after the unnamed boy was rushed to the hospital on Aug. 20, 2025. Nicole Maxwell was arrested in Indian River County and is in the jail there. Robert Maxwell and Koon are in the St. Lucie County jail. Deputies, detectives, and crime scene investigators responded to Lawnwood Regional Medical Center after a child was brought to the emergency room by the child's grandparents. Medical personnel advised responding deputies that the child had been pronounced deceased and exhibited injuries and conditions consistent with possible neglect.
